integrity: The graph, every independent face, every matching pair, every Hasse cover, acyclicity of the full Morse orientation, and a separate mod-2 boundary-rank computation are reconstructed by the bundled verifier. No numerical approximation is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite computation for the single canonical Shrikhande graph and does not assert a family theorem; literature novelty remains bounded by the aliases and sources inspected, with a residual risk from inaccessible or unindexed material.
title: The Shrikhande independence complex is a wedge of twenty-three 2-spheres
